sentences.text: Shri V.K.Saxena, learned Senior counsel with Shri Saurabh Agrawal, counsel for the petitioner.
Shri R.K.Upadhyaya, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.
Heard on admission.
Revision appears to be arguable.
Hence, the revision is admitted for final hearing.
Heard on I.A.No.1444/2019 an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the petitioner.

The petitioner has been convicted under Sections 7 (5) read with Section 16 (1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for a period of six months with a fine of Rs.1000/- and Section 7 (3) read with Section 16(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act sentenced till rising of the Court with a fine of Rs.500/- with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the matter.
During the trial, the petitioner was on bail.
He did not misuse the liberty granted to him.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the fine amount has already been deposited.
Hearing of this revision shall take some time.
Under these HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Rahul Jain Vs The State of M.P.) circumstances, he prays for bail and suspension of jail sentence.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (Rahul Jain Vs The State of M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for rejection of application.

After considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the rival parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, it would be appropriate to accept the application of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Consequently, I.A. No.1444/2019 is hereby allowed.

If the petitioner furnish bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 29th August,
2019 and on subsequent dates given by the office for appearance till the disposal of the present revision then the petitioner shall be released on bail and execution of jail sentence is suspended till the disposal of this revision.
C.c. as per rules.

(Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava) Judge AK/-
